This is direct evidence that he chose compromise and de-escalation when a peaceful regional alternative existed.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu seeks dialogue with protesters, asks them to suspend demonstrations","publisher":"TheCable","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/","summary":"Tinubu asked protesters to suspend demonstrations to “create room for dialogue” and said he had heard them “loud and clear.” This is direct evidence of a crisis choice to preserve channels rather than default immediately to force.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged deaths, destruction, and unrest, and addressed the public in a conciliatory broadcast rather than only through security language. This supports a partial de-escalation reading, though it did not concede protesters’ core demands.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Statement on the Killings of Soldiers in Aba","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"June 2, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-statement-on-the-killings-of-soldiers-in-aba/","summary":"Tinubu said the government would “come down heavily” and that the armed forces had the capacity to crush violent non-state actors. This is strong counterevidence: where a peaceful alternative existed, his public posture here was coercive rather than de-escalatory.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8","1B.5","1B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: I’ll Do All Within My Powers To Equip, Arm The Military","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"August 23, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-ill-do-all-within-my-powers-to-equip-arm-the-military/","summary":"Tinubu emphasized arming and equipping the military and stressed readiness. This reinforces the view that force remained a preferred or at least heavily weighted option in his security posture.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8","1B.5"]},{"title":"Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"Reuters reported that the government said it was open to dialogue before the protests, even as security forces deployed in major cities. This is mixed evidence: dialogue was available, but the state still prepared coercive force in parallel.","question_ids":["2B.1","1B.8"]}]}
